Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
"Synesios has two votes. You may pay a pool when you play a
Master: Out-of-Turn card to gain an extra master phase action
in your next master phase. Synesios cannot use cards that
require Celerity. Scarce."

If you use Synesios's ability, can you play additional M:OOT
cards against your new Master Phase Action(s)? Or is it just
once?
If not, is there ever a way to be able to play more than one
M:OOT per "round"?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
>
> "Synesios has two votes. You may pay a pool when you play a
> Master: Out-of-Turn card to gain an extra master phase action
> in your next master phase. Synesios cannot use cards that
> require Celerity. Scarce."
>
> If you use Synesios's ability, can you play additional M:OOT
> cards against your new Master Phase Action(s)? Or is it just
> once?

This is stated explicitly in the rules. [1.6.2.3]

> If not, is there ever a way to be able to play more than one
> M:OOT per "round"?

Card text could, in theory, override the rules. But no cards
currently override that rule. The best you can do is gain more
turns per "round" - Reversal of Fortunes during a Madness Network
action, for instance.
